mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, name, species, breed, age, weight, icon, profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl FROM pets WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pets (user_id, name, species, breed, age, weight, icon, profile_image_url) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{species}, #{breed}, #{age}, #{weight}, #{icon}, #{profileImageUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE pets SET name = #{name}, species = #{species}, breed = #{breed}, age = #{age}, weight = #{weight}, icon = #{icon}, profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl} WHERE id = #{id}
